summary: Silver Springs State Fish and Wildlife Area is an Illinois state park in Kendall County, established in the late 1960s and named for a natural spring within its boundaries. The park has two artificial lakes, the Fox River flows through its northern end, and it offers fishing, hunting, boating and hiking. It also includes native prairie restoration areas, a sledding hill and a seven-mile equestrian trail.
one_line: Silver Springs State Fish and Wildlife Area is an Illinois state park in Kendall County offering fishing, hunting, boating, hiking, and prairie restoration.

The park has a sledding hill.
